title: Android: (Stack trace) - SIGBUS [split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so] object.cpp - Object::_predelete()
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.2.stable

### System information

Google Pixel 7, Android 17 (SDK 37)

### Issue description

Device: google panther (Google Pixel 7)
Android version: Android 17 (SDK 37)
Issue visibility: Foreground

Clay had this to say in rocketchat:
```
...  likely an engine issue. It's crashing when freeing a control node. So it's unlikely to be your fault unless you are using C# or another language where you have more control over memory than GDScript and you accidentally are feeding a node that has already been freed
```

The project is GDScript only, no C# or other languages used.
